description: List the public exploit code and proofs of concept the sources link to one vulnerability: Metasploit exploit modules, Exploit-DB entries, references NVD or the CNA tagged as exploits (broken links left out), and GitHub PoC repositories (most stars first). Links only; nothing is downloaded or run. The same JSON as GET /api/v1/entries/{id}/pocs. GitHub PoCs and tagged references are unverified third-party code, and stars are popularity, not review.

id.description: A CVE, GHSA, EUVD or OSV ID, such as CVE-2021-44228.

sources.description: Only these sources. All by default.

name: get_poc

counts.description: Links per source, before the sources filter.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same arguments, for the next page.

public_exploit.description: Whether the entry counts as having public exploit code for scoring.

title: Find public exploits and proofs of concept
